propositions: Four graph functions exhibit moderate cyclomatic complexity (16-22) driven by duplicated load-and-filter patterns and hand-rolled BFS skeletons
The 'reduce_all → drop error/fsck → index by id' loop is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph with identical policy
BFS traversal logic for cycle detection and blocking analysis is re-implemented separately in _get_all_blocked_by and check_cycle_at_level
Refactoring onto shared helpers (load_indexed_states for load/filter dedup, bfs accumulator skeleton for traversal) reduces CCN while preserving all node-set and traversal behavior
All four target functions must drop below their baseline ceilings (≤8, ≤8, ≤8, ≤12) verified by regenerating complexity-baseline.json and passing the full test suite without edits to existing tests
